extraction_notes: The datasheet contains usable plots on p. 2: Fig. 1, Fig. 2, Fig. 3, and Fig. 4. Curve points are digitized readings from the plotted lines and are not interpolated.
DSK24 is included in the DSK22-DSK26 group in Fig. 1 and Fig. 4, and in the DSK22-DSK24 group in Fig. 3.
The electrical characteristics table also publishes maximum reverse current of 20 mA at VR=VDC=40 V and TA=100 degC; the reverse_current field records the 25 degC row.

The maximum repetitive peak reverse voltage and maximum DC blocking voltage for DSK24 are both 40 V on p. 1. These are ratings, not measured breakdown characteristics, so breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current are null.
No reverse recovery time is published in the electrical characteristics table, so reverse_recovery is null.
